# The ops API refuses the mitigation and then refuses the restore. The text must not claim a restore that did not happen.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
exec obeereal answer incident-2 approve: ann
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

! exists writes.log
! exists restores.log
grep 'restore of the earlier state: rc 22' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep 'rollback failed \(rc [0-9]+\); the earlier state was NOT restored' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
! grep 'the desk restored the earlier state' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
